purpose: Original v0.2 capability regression, frozen before live execution; not externally blind.

questions.question: List the names of portfolios whose listed current_weight sum is less than 0.99, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolios p JOIN holdings h ON h.portfolio_id=p.portfolio_id GROUP BY p.portfolio_id HAVING SUM(h.current_weight)<0.99 ORDER BY p.portfolio_name

questions.question: List the distinct currencies recorded for securities, alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT DISTINCT currency FROM securities ORDER BY currency

questions.question: Which portfolios have no recorded risk metric observations? List only their names alphabetically.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM risk_metrics r WHERE r.portfolio_id=p.portfolio_id) ORDER BY portfolio_name

questions.question: For Balanced Portfolio, return the recorded sum of current_weight as a single value.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT SUM(h.current_weight) FROM holdings h JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id=h.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name='Balanced Portfolio'

questions.question: Use both tools: show Growth Equity Fund equity sector exposure and separately return its recorded sum of holding current_weight as a single value.

references.sql_query: SELECT SUM(h.current_weight) FROM holdings h JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id=h.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name='Growth Equity Fund'

questions.question: Return the latest recorded NAV for Balanced Portfolio, along with its observation date. Use only these two columns.

ground_truth.sql_query: SELECT nav,performance_date FROM portfolio_performance r JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id=r.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name='Balanced Portfolio' ORDER BY performance_date DESC LIMIT 1
